hero.title: The Complete LYST Feature Codex
hero.description: This page is the complete index of digital capabilities. Every feature is organized into three editorial groups: Manage, Experience, and Remember.

categories.manage: RSVP responses, guest management, automatic reminders, event information, and personal links.
categories.experience: Event camera, disposable mode, voice guestbook, hidden moments, letters from the room, and live polls.
categories.remember: Shared gallery, delayed reminders, digital time capsule, video messages, and the event archive.

manage.title: Management Tools
manage.description: Guest responses, statuses, reminders, and event details, all in one workspace.

rsvp.description: Guests confirm attendance in a single click, adding plus-ones and specific dietary requirements right there.

guestList.title: Detailed Guest List
guestList.description: Track every guest and their status in real time. Group them by table, category, or response from one convenient panel.

location.title: Location, Time & Dress Code
location.description: Give guests instant map navigation, calendar links, and visual dress-code inspiration, all in one intuitive interface.

reminders.title: Automatic Reminders
reminders.description: Schedule reminders and notices for set times before the event. Guests automatically receive updates and reminders.
reminders.infoSubtitle: At the times you set before the event

customUrl.description: Create a personal link that takes guests straight into the event's digital experience. It simplifies reminders, RSVPs, and sharing event details.
customUrl.urlSubtitle: Guests go straight to the event page
customUrl.shareTitle: Share the link on any channel
customUrl.shareSubtitle: SMS, WhatsApp, email, or social media

experience.title: The Event Experience
experience.description: A digital camera, voice guestbook, hidden moments, and live polls - the event doesn't end when guests leave the room.

cards.name: Event Camera
cards.description: Guests take and upload photos straight from the link. A disposable digital camera with a fun effect.

cards.name: Disposable Camera Mode
cards.description: Guests shoot photos in a disposable-camera style. Photos merge into the gallery as soon as they're uploaded.

cards.name: Voice Guestbook
cards.description: Capture the real emotion. Voice greetings and messages that will move or crack you up years later.

cards.name: Hidden Moments
cards.description: Hidden moments and letters that automatically unlock at a time you choose in the future.

cards.name: Letters From the Room
cards.description: Guests can leave anonymous or personal letters and thanks right as the event wraps up.

cards.name: Live Event Polls
cards.description: Actively engage guests with live polls. Create questions about the music, the playlist, the next event, or the event's vibe.

remember.title: Memory Archive
remember.description: Photos, voice messages, video messages, and a time capsule - everything in one digital archive.

cards.name: Shared Gallery
cards.description: Every shot taken by every guest comes together in one polished, living digital archive.

cards.name: Message for Later
cards.description: Photos stay locked until 9:00 AM the day after the event, building a special sense of anticipation.

cards.name: Digital Time Capsule
cards.description: Hidden moments and letters that automatically unlock at a time you choose in the future.

cards.name: Video Messages
cards.description: Guests record video messages and greetings that merge into one digital archive after the event.

cards.name: Event Archive
cards.description: After the event, all content and messages are stored in a digital archive that stays accessible for years to come.

cta.title: Start your first digital adventure
cta.description: Create a completely different kind of anticipation and turn your guests into co-authors of the event.
